name: Low product usage on my account
description: Usage of a purchased product is under 20% of the quantity bought, at least six months after purchase. Alerts when a month's report shows it. The demo's usage data is synthetic.
title: Low usage of {product} at {account}
explain: Fired because {account}, an account on your account team, used {used} of the {purchased} {product} bought on {purchasedOn} ({percent}%) in {month}. That is under the 20% line, more than six months after purchase. Data source: {source}.
